release_name: Live TV v3.8 — Permanent Auto-Reconnecting Remote Hub & Zero-Config Bonjour
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🛡️ Permanent Remote Auto-Reconnect: Remote now permanently survives router IP changes, DHCP renewals and Wi-Fi reconnections
🌐 Zero-Config Apple Bonjour (.local): Direct support for permanent 'SAMs-MacBook-Pro.local' domain that never breaks
🔍 High-Speed Wi-Fi Subnet Scanner: Mobile remote automatically sweeps your local Wi-Fi subnet in <2 seconds if the Mac's IP ever shifts
⚡ Live macOS Network Monitor: Real-time NWPathMonitor dynamically updates remote QR codes on screen whenever your Wi-Fi interface changes
🪟 Interactive Drag-to-Resize PiP: Resize PiP screen height and width by dragging the bottom-right handle or window edges with fixed 16:9 aspect ratio
🎬 Remote Video Quality Switcher: Change video resolution from the mobile remote (Auto, 1080p FHD, 720p HD, 480p SD, 360p Low)
⭐ Bidirectional Mac Favorites Sync: Your Mac's favorited channels are instantly visible and synchronized on the phone remote under 'Favorites'
⏮⏭ Remote Next & Previous Channel: Rapid channel navigation via dedicated CH + / CH - stepper rockers and Now Playing quick controls
Added Discovery Bangla, Discovery Kids Bangla, Discovery Science HD, Discovery Turbo HD with multi-server failover
2,989 total live channels with 3-server instant auto-failover
